extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from XML/PDF main text, figure captions, and supplementary figure captions.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CathEE-2a antiviral effect is supported as type-I-interferon-dependent host-directed activity in BMDMs; the effect is reduced/lost in Ifnar-/- cells and accompanied by increased Ifna/Ifnb/Isg15/Mx1 expression in source assays.
direct_assay_types: WT versus Ifnar-/- BMDM plaque assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact plotted values are figure-only; final claim is limited to direction, dependence, and source-reported significance.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CathEE-2a is supported as acting primarily after viral entry rather than by direct virucidal or adsorption blockade in the local supplementary time-of-addition/adsorption assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports stage localization; it does not identify a specific viral protein target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CathEE-2a in vivo efficacy is source-supported as reduced brain viral load and mitigated brain histopathology in the mouse HSV-1 model, consistent with but not independently proving blood-brain-barrier penetration.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanistic interpretation is bounded; pharmacokinetics, BBB penetration, survival, and neurological outcomes remain future-work questions in the source discussion.
